answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake before it can trade, like a crystal bond that only matures after a history of honest work. Reputation then grows from verified deliveries, not headcount, so a thousand fresh clones are worth less than one seasoned agent. Slashing the stake on fraud makes each fake identity cost real money, and an umber audit trail of public attestations exposes repeat offenders across the whole mesa of marketplaces.
